tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, bottom sheets, dialogs, the app bar and the bottom navigation.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Input fills, keypad keys, inactive segments and skeleton blocks.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between list rows and inside cards. Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input, checkbox and outlined-button borders: at least 3:1 on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken, brand-soft and every *-soft status fill.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (dates, handler, path crumbs, helper text) on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Ledger green. Primary buttons, the add button, active navigation, selected controls and links; as text on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and brand-soft.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Selected chip and navigation-indicator fill behind ink or brand text.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill (the primary button label, the add button glyph).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brass. Non-state highlights only: the cover, onboarding progress, the selected period marker. Never a money direction or a status. 3:1 as a mark on all surfaces.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard and switch-access focus ring: 2px gap in the ground colour, then a solid 2px ring. At least 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dim layer behind bottom sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: money-in
tokens.usage: Money In / Credit / Avak amounts and the in-arrow glyph, on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and money-in-soft. Always with a + sign and the in-arrow.

tokens.name: money-in-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind the Money In tag.

tokens.name: money-out
tokens.usage: Money Out / Debit / Javak amounts and the out-arrow glyph, on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and money-out-soft. Always with a minus sign and the out-arrow.

tokens.name: money-out-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind the Money Out tag.

tokens.name: transfer
tokens.usage: Transfer amounts (same owner, different place) and the swap glyph; no sign. On surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and transfer-soft.

tokens.name: transfer-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind the Transfer tag, and the Draft and Queued badges.

tokens.name: pending
tokens.usage: Pending approval and Posting text and the clock glyph, on the surfaces and pending-soft.

tokens.name: pending-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind the Pending badge and the reserved segment of a fund bar.

tokens.name: blocked
tokens.usage: Blocked, Rejected, failed and destructive: text, glyph and the danger button, on the surfaces and blocked-soft.

tokens.name: blocked-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind the Blocked badge and the conflict block.

tokens.name: reversed
tokens.usage: Reversed and Corrected: text, the undo glyph and the strike-through on the original amount, on the surfaces and reversed-soft.

tokens.name: reversed-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind the Reversed badge.

tokens.name: outstanding
tokens.usage: Outstanding, receivable, payable, advance and reimbursement due: text and the hourglass glyph, on the surfaces and outstanding-soft.

tokens.name: outstanding-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind the Outstanding badge and the outstanding segment of a fund bar.

tokens.name: reconciled
tokens.usage: Posted, Reconciled, Settled and Verified: text and the check glyph, on the surfaces and reconciled-soft. Teal, so it never relies on a red-green split against blocked.

tokens.name: reconciled-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind the Posted and Reconciled badges.

tokens.name: exception
tokens.usage: Exception-engine findings and inline warnings (possible duplicate, unusual amount, missing receipt): text and the warning glyph, on the surfaces and exception-soft.

tokens.name: exception-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind the Exception badge and warning rows.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Generic success (saved, verified); an alias of reconciled.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind success messages.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Validation and system errors; an alias of blocked.

tokens.name: error-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind error messages.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings that need review before saving; an alias of exception.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind warnings.

tokens.name: security-standard
tokens.usage: Share and document security level Standard / Internal (no protection).

tokens.name: security-protected
tokens.usage: Security level Protected / Secure (password, encryption).

tokens.name: security-confidential
tokens.usage: Security level Confidential / Restricted (adds watermark, expiry).

tokens.name: security-owner
tokens.usage: Security level Owner Secure / Owner-only / Private (everything mandatory).

families.sans: "Mukta", "Mukta Vaani", "Noto Sans Devanagari", "Noto Sans Gujarati", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Home greeting and setup screens only; one per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: App-bar titles, sheet and dialog titles.

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: Sticky date headers, card titles, group labels.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Cash received from Mint, placed in the Tijori.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary lines in rows and cards.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, helper text, chart legends. Never for amounts.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, badge and tag text.

styles.name: amount-hero
styles.usage: The one total a screen is about (home total, the amount being entered).

styles.name: amount-lg
styles.usage: Card balances and the amount on detail, review and proof screens.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Amounts in transaction rows and lists.

styles.name: amount-sm
styles.usage: Amounts inside breakdowns, tables and legends.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Transaction IDs, references and dates in tables (tabular figures).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related items: chips, sign and amount, row lines.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner padding of chips and compact rows; gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter, card padding, list-row padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Bottom-sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap above a screen primary action; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Top inset of full-screen states (unlock, empty, denied).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target (same as size touch-min).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Large separations on setup screens.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Bar segments and small marks.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, tags, chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, keypad keys, banners.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and proof cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets; dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, the add button, avatars. In SVG use half the short side instead.

tokens.name: elevation-1
tokens.usage: Cards resting on surface.

tokens.name: elevation-2
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and the bottom navigation.

tokens.name: elevation-3
tokens.usage: The add button, dialogs and snackbars.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum width and height of anything tappable.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon size.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside badges, chips and dense rows.

tokens.name: field-height
tokens.usage: Text fields and selectors.

tokens.name: key-height
tokens.usage: Amount keypad and M-PIN keys.

tokens.name: app-bar
tokens.usage: Top app bar height (title plus context path).

tokens.name: nav-bar
tokens.usage: Bottom navigation height.

tokens.name: fab
tokens.usage: The add button.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls, always with a reason line when the user knows the control exists.

tokens.name: opacity-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state layer over a control.

tokens.name: opacity-hover
tokens.usage: Focus or drag state layer.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Press feedback.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Chips, toggles, badges changing.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Screen-level fades, snackbar in and out.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and dialogs entering. All motion drops to 0 when the system asks for reduced motion.
